meta.system: Aetherial Mercury - Base per user token table
meta.source: INTERNAL/UI and Component.md:10 + user provided 9-token table, Aetherial Mercury wins
meta.fonts: Geist Pixel Square for technical labels only, JetBrains Mono omnibox/telemetry, Inter titles

usage.accentPrimary: Liquid Chrome - Active tabs, primary buttons, focus rings
usage.accentInteractive: Ghostly Iris - Hover states, link hints, secondary glow - replaces Neon Cyan
usage.accentDanger: Reserved for privacy alerts and blocked-tracker visualizations. Unchanged.
usage.accentArchive: Pulsar Gold - Contextual only when Sovereign Archive is active: Time Machine dropdown, 404-recovery banner, Offline Mode indicator. Must never appear during live browsing.

kit.icon: Lucide 1.75px stroke, 20px box, outline-only, sharp/round join - strict 24x24 grid, 2px path, tabular-nums for JetBrains Mono
kit.bordersOverShadows: 1px solid borderSubtle paired with bg contrast, not drop shadows
kit.buttons: rounded-sm 2px or rounded-none 0px, never rounded-full pill clash with pixel, px-3 py-1.5 small, px-4 py-2 primary, 8px increments
kit.tables: tabular-nums on all numerical cells, hover transition-colors duration-100 ease-out

typography.geistPixelUsage: Short, fixed-width technical labels only (link hints a/s/d/f, Waterfall status codes, Shield counters) - not body or omnibox
typography.jetBrainsUsage: Omnibox and all telemetry/data-dense output (Waterfall, Console)
typography.interUsage: Page titles and general UI chrome text
